title: Propagating T5-phages for Fluorescent Staining
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.igzcbx6
materials: The next morning, prewarm LB-agar plates to 37ºC
Melt 0.6% top agar in the microwave
Evert plates and return to 37ºC incubator

steps.title: Prepare E.coli Culture
steps.instruction: Grow a culture of E.coli ATCC11303 in LB media overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Pellet 1 mL of the cells in an Eppendorf tube at 10,000 xg for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet into 1 mL of 10 mM MgSO4.

steps.title: Prepare Top Agar Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare sterile 5 mL tubes and pipet 3 mL of melted top agar into each.

substeps.instruction: Keep tubes in a 45ºC heat block or water bath to maintain liquid state without killing cells.

steps.title: Infect Cells with T5 Phage
steps.instruction: Infect the resuspended cells with T5 phage stock.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL T5 from the stock (except for the control) to 100 µL of resuspended cells.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Plate Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Combine infected cells with top agar and plate.

substeps.instruction: Add the infected cells to the molten top agar.
Pour onto a prewarmed LB agar plate and tilt the plate to spread.

steps.title: Harvest Phages
steps.instruction: Collect phages once confluent plaques appear on the plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of sterile phage buffer (10 mM MgSO4, 1 mM CaCl2, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1% gelatin).
Let the plates sit overnight at 4ºC with the buffer on top to gather the phages.

steps.title: Purify Phage Lysate
steps.instruction: Extract and clarify the phage solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the liquid from the plates to a sterile tube.
Add 100 µL chloroform and 5 mL phage buffer.
Shake for 1 minute to allow chloroform to settle out.
Transfer 4 mL of the supernatant to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Filter and Store Phages
steps.instruction: Remove cellular debris and store the phage stock.

substeps.instruction: Filter the solution using a 0.22 µm pore size syringe filter.
